title: Showdown
description: Heads-up poker in the terminal against an LLM opponent that talks trash, remembers the match, and reacts when it loses.

title: Optimal Ban Selection in League of Legends
description: Formalized ban value as a counterfactual — a ban substitutes an opponent rather than removing one. Built a resumable Match-V5 ingest over 182k ranked games across six tiers, and recovered champion-by-champion interaction effects by method of moments net of sampling variance.

title: One-Dimensional Heat Equation
description: Derived the explicit FTCS scheme from second-order Taylor expansions and implemented a vectorized solver with configurable boundary and initial conditions, validated against analytical solutions.

title: Logistic Regression from Scratch
description: Implemented logistic regression by maximizing log-likelihood with gradient ascent, no ML libraries, on ~10k individuals' ancestry genetic records.
